arms.script:
-- Agent proof, the scripted floor: the task `wf bench agent-proof` hands an agent, written by hand.
-- wf browser run --script docs/runbooks/scripts/agent-proof.lua --arg base=http://127.0.0.1:8810/mla-tamagui
local base = args.base or "http://127.0.0.1:8810/mla-tamagui"

device:open(base .. "/leetcode/two-sum")
device:wait("id:ProblemEditorRunLocalButton")
-- the editor autofocuses and its keyboard covers Run Local: Done ends the toolbar's action row, off screen until it scrolls
if device:appears("id:EditorHelperRails", 3) then
  local rails = device:find("id:EditorHelperRails")
  local y = rails.bottom - 25
  for _ = 1, 3 do -- a swipe during the first render is lost
    device:swipe(303, y, 20, y, 400)
    if device:appears("id:EditorAction-Done", 1) then break end
  end
  device:wait("id:EditorAction-Done")
  device:tap("id:EditorAction-Done")
  device:wait_gone("id:EditorHelperRails")
end
device:tap("id:ProblemEditorRunLocalButton")
device:wait("id:ProblemEditorRunOutcomeTotals")
local totals = device:text("id:ProblemEditorRunOutcomeTotals") or ""
log(totals)
assert_that(totals:find("passed", 1, true), "the outcome totals do not say passed: " .. totals)

device:open(args.base .. "/leetcode/two-sum")
device:wait("id:ProblemEditorRunLocalButton")

if device:appears("id:EditorHelperRails", 3) then
  for _ = 1, 3 do
    local rails = device:find("id:EditorHelperRails")
    assert_that(rails ~= nil, "EditorHelperRails disappeared before Done was reached")
    device:swipe(303, rails.bottom - 25, 20, rails.bottom - 25)
    if device:appears("id:EditorAction-Done", 1) then
      break
    end
  end
  device:wait("id:EditorAction-Done")
  device:tap("id:EditorAction-Done")
  device:wait_gone("id:EditorHelperRails")
end

device:tap("id:ProblemEditorRunLocalButton")

device:wait("id:ProblemEditorRunOutcomeTotals")
local totals = device:text("id:ProblemEditorRunOutcomeTotals")
assert_that(totals ~= nil and totals:find("passed", 1, true) ~= nil,
  "run outcome does not contain 'passed': " .. tostring(totals))

device:open(args.base .. "/leetcode/two-sum")

if device:appears("id:EditorHelperRails", 3) then
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        local rails = device:find("id:EditorHelperRails")
        device:swipe(303, rails.bottom - 25, 20, rails.bottom - 25)
        if device:appears("id:EditorAction-Done", 1) then
            break
        end
    end
    device:wait("id:EditorAction-Done")
    device:tap("id:EditorAction-Done")
    device:wait_gone("id:EditorHelperRails")
end

device:wait("id:ProblemEditorRunLocalButton")
device:tap("id:ProblemEditorRunLocalButton")
device:wait("id:ProblemEditorRunOutcomeTotals")
local text = device:text("id:ProblemEditorRunOutcomeTotals")
assert_that(text and text:find("passed"), "totals missing 'passed': " .. tostring(text))
